private_hall.decision: No floor furniture. Mirror and ceiling lights; family linen in expanded bedroom wardrobe.

kitchen_island.assessment: The longitudinal fit leaves only 982 mm for both aisles combined. Rotating a practical island would still require end access in the remaining 1582 mm depth and interfere with east entry / service flow. Reject an island inside the existing enclosed kitchen.

open_kitchen.decision: Do not change canonical geometry. A separate wall/structure/extraction and furniture study would be needed after explicit architectural approval. No island substituted for the comfortable six-seat dining arrangement.

planting.decision: One 1650 mm high specimen in reception, not multiple small floor pots; exact species depends on daylight and household needs, TBD. No kitchen worktop or hall plant added.

accessories.decision: Use the existing single large artwork, one sideboard lamp, purposeful rugs and bedroom closed storage. No gallery wall or third reception seating group.
